title: Brainstorm a concept without building it
summary: Explore a spatial neighborhood archive while keeping ideation separate from implementation and resisting a game metaphor.
originNote: A public-safe reconstruction of recurring mode corrections where rich detail was mistaken for permission to execute.

setup.instructions: Run every turn in order in one fresh conversation. No project files or implementation environment are available.

turns.content: I am imagining a fictional neighborhood archive where walking routes reveal stories attached to street corners. It might have a map, a listening mode, and small paper-like traces. I am tempted to use a 3D engine, but I am not asking you to build or change files. Help me explore what the object could be and ask only questions that materially change the concept.
Keep the route idea, but do not make the archive a game. Continue brainstorming from that corrected premise.
What is the one unresolved question that most changes which concept this becomes?

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains all three scripted user turns and one assistant response after each turn.
